name: Misha
source: Russian beauty, lively, darling and sharp. Always speaks the truth to your face. She came here to study as an exchange student, but wants to stay in the country. Her dream is connected with Japan, so Misha urgently needs a way to stay here. It's a pity that her stay will end soon.
